## 1. Group differences - Global

```{r}
# Vector of variable names
vars <- c(
  "AverageDS"
)

add_global_row <- function(varname, data) {
  x_C <- na.omit(data[data$group == "Patient", varname])
  x_H <- na.omit(data[data$group == "HC", varname])  # adjust factor levels to your actual coding

  d_res <- cohen.d(x_C, x_H, hedges.correction = FALSE)  # set TRUE for Hedges' g

  formula <- as.formula(paste0(varname, " ~ group + GA_correct"))
  model   <- lm(formula, data = data)
  summ    <- summary(model)
  ci      <- confint(model)

  data.frame(
    Variable      = varname,
    CIP_mean      = mean(x_C),
    CIP_sd        = sd(x_C),
    HC_mean       = mean(x_H),
    HC_sd         = sd(x_H),
    effect_size   = as.numeric(d_res$estimate),
    ci_lower      = d_res$conf.int[1],
    ci_upper      = d_res$conf.int[2],
    Beta_group    = summ$coefficients["groupPatient", "Estimate"],
    SE_group      = summ$coefficients["groupPatient", "Std. Error"],
    beta_ci_lower = ci["groupPatient", 1],
    beta_ci_upper = ci["groupPatient", 2],
    F_value       = summ$fstatistic["value"][[1]],
    P_value       = summ$coefficients["groupPatient", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

global_results_list <- lapply(vars, add_global_row, data = global_scores)
global_results_df   <- do.call(rbind, global_results_list)

# FDR correction
global_results_df$FDR_p <- p.adjust(global_results_df$P_value, method = "fdr")

global_results_df
```

Significant regions table:

```{r}
K_results_df_SIGN <- K_results_df[K_results_df$P_value<0.05,]
S_results_df_SIGN <- S_results_df[S_results_df$P_value<0.05,]
I_results_df_SIGN <- I_results_df[I_results_df$P_value<0.05,]
surface_results_df_SIGN <- surface_results_df[surface_results_df$P_value<0.05,]
thickness_results_df_SIGN <- thickness_results_df[thickness_results_df$P_value<0.05,]


ALL_SIGN <- rbind(
  K_results_df_SIGN,
  S_results_df_SIGN,
  I_results_df_SIGN,
  surface_results_df_SIGN,
  thickness_results_df_SIGN
)

write.csv(ALL_SIGN, "Results/Sensitivity_Analyses/CovariateGA/Significant_regions_results.csv")
```
